source_title: OKX will launch WLD/USDT at 09:20am July 24, 2023 (UTC)

spot_trading_start.statement: OKX's exact-time follow-up announced that WLD/USDT spot trading was scheduled to open at 09:20 UTC on 2023-07-24.

limitations: This record authenticates the project's source check, not an immutable copy of the third-party webpage.
This exact-time follow-up is used instead of the earlier conditional notice that did not state a trading clock time.
